item.title: MONTGOMERY COUNTY SWAT TAKES WANTED FELON INTO CUSTODY
item.description: On January 14, 2026, Montgomery County Sheriff’s Office SWAT Operators, deputized as Task Force Officers with the United States Marshals Service Fugitive Task Force, arrested wanted fugitive Cory Allmand.
